answer: Make the buyers pay for fakes too. Every client posts a 10-token hiring bond before a job starts; if the agent is proven a clone within 20 epochs, the bond burns and the client loses hiring rights for five epochs. Clients hiring only verified agents get the bond back plus a 1-token rebate each epoch. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 1,000 clients risking $10,000, while one honest agent costs its client nothing. Trust spreads like a plume of smoke from one chimney, easy to trace, and a clone army is a sparrow flocking to a single feeder: a shale-thin excuse for a thousand identical beaks.
